title: Wagetype Security Roles — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The roles allowed to see a secured wagetype. Not enforced at present: nothing restricts access to a wagetype, whatever is listed here.

fields.label: WageTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wagetype master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The secured wagetype.

Example. Executive Bonus

fields.label: RoleId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Role master data.
fields.html:
What it is. A role allowed to see it.

Example. Payroll Manager

Why it matters. Each role can be listed once per wagetype.
